6.177 rsUnsortedCategoryInAreaChart
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsUnsortedCategoryInAreaChart is a critical error that will occur if, for a Chart with Chart.Type set to
"Area" and Axis.Scalar set to true within Chart.CategoryAxis, the SortBy.SortExpression is not
identical to the value of Grouping.GroupExpressions within the same DynamicCategories element.
